summary: Force browser UI validation and related browser execution through EKODI-owned native virtualization in a fixed recovery order before any external browser fallback, and require HTTP 4xx/5xx response evidence in the native browser worker.
approvalBasis: The EKODI Platform Super Administrator explicitly instructed EKODI to coordinate this as a forced execution rule and build it after confirming that EKODI's own virtual browser must be used instead of TinyFish by default.
implementation: config/background-browser-worker-policy.json external-default prohibition and HTTP error evidence
config/surface-system-verification-policy.json native browser order and fallback evidence
mandatoryRules: browser UI validation order is EKODI Background Browser Worker then EKODI Native Remote Computer then Autonomous Execution Fabric
external browser services are forbidden by default
external browser fallback is allowed only when every eligible native route has machine-readable allowed failure evidence
external fallback requires audit id, native gap record, security-equivalent-or-stronger isolation and no paid automatic upgrade
every external fallback creates a native recovery task and retries native execution on the next eligible run
browser evidence captures HTTP 4xx/5xx URL, status, status text and resource type in addition to console, page and request failures
service, agent, provider, workspace and learning-loop waivers are forbidden
rollback: Revert Constitution v1.27.1 and native browser execution-order bindings to v1.27.0 through the guarded C2 path while preserving the last known working EKODI Background Browser Worker runtime evidence until a replacement is explicitly approved.
